newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK dlr stable, money market quiet, forwards wide.
newsitem.headline: HK dlr stable, money market quiet, forwards wide.

text.p: * Hong Kong dollar stable and quiet
* Currency forwards widening as U.S. banks liquidate forward positions on Hong Kong dollar profit-taking
* Overnight slightly soft on spillover effect from Hong Kong stock market sell-off, but weakness expected to end with anticipated return of strength to stocks
* Notes range-bound, with dealers less convinced than their U.S. counterparts of a delay in a rise in U.S. interest rates at the Federal Open Market Committee meeting in July
* Hong Kong dealers looking for U.S. retail sales data rather than taking comfort in weaker-than-expected non-farm payrolls report last Friday
* EFN yields: 3yr 6.43 pct, 5yr 6.77 pct, 7yr 7.03 pct, one week 5.69 pct
